codigos.codigo: void setup() { pinMode(9, OUTPUT); pinMode(10, OUTPUT); pinMode(11, OUTPUT); } void loop() { analogWrite(9, 255); analogWrite(10, 0); analogWrite(11, 255); delay(1000); analogWrite(9, 255); analogWrite(10, 255); analogWrite(11, 0); delay(1000); analogWrite(9, 0); analogWrite(10, 255); analogWrite(11, 0); delay(1000); }
